messages:
maria: Heads-up — canary 2.3.0 deployed to EU at ~10:12. Seeing dashboards freeze for ~3–5s on initial open, charts don't stream. Repro on Chrome and Firefox.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 2.3.0 -> eu finished at 1739123450 (sha: a1b2c3). :white_check_mark:

ashwin: Is this the bundle swap we rolled yesterday? Any telemetry links?

jen: Attaching traces — https://internal.telemetry/trace/abcd :point_right: main-thread parse spiked ~4200ms on first paint for dashboards with >6 widgets.

jen: ```
MAIN_THREAD_PARSE: 4200ms
CHUNK_DOWNLOAD: 300ms
EVAL_EXECUTE: 3500ms
kvcache_hit_rate: 0.48
```

kevin: Looks like chunk eval timing, not network. We moved a big vendor (analytics-core) into a runtime/shared chunk in the last splitChunks tweak — that forces eager parse during hydration.

lisa: Telemetry shows prefix/KV cache hit-rate dropped after canary. Might be a key-name change or cache invalidation during bundle-swap. Also saw more full-page evals.

ashwin: Repro steps?

maria: Open /dashboards -> load a dashboard with many sparklines -> note ~3–5s main-thread jank before charts render, CPU goes to 90% on first open.

jen: Grepped the 2.3.0 chunk-manifest: analytics-core is referenced by runtime instead of async vendor. Suspect build config change: webpack.optimize.splitChunks.cacheGroups.analytics changed.

kevin: Short-term mitigations: revert the splitChunks change and publish 2.3.1, or convert the import to dynamic: `import('analytics-core')` so it doesn't block hydration. Also could tweak routing policy to steer canary traffic away from hot paths while we patch.

lisa: Also saw route-affinity header stripped at CDN edge for some requests — could explain KV cache miss. Need to confirm with eng-infra.

ashwin: Can we hold the canary? It's at 10% traffic.

maria: Propose immediate hold for EU, and rollback to 2.2.9 if we can't patch quickly. Opened PR for a revert: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pulls/4582

ashwin: I'll prepare a hotfix that makes analytics dynamic and gate it behind a feature flag so we can toggle without a full rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollout hold triggered by @maria at 1739123555. :warning:

kevin: I'll own the hotfix + canary bake. Plan: change import, set TELEMETRY_EAGER_IMPORT=false for canary env, republish a limited canary to eu-staging, watch main-thread parse and kvcache hit-rate.

jen: Also recommend adding a lightweight chart placeholder UI while widgets hydrate to decouple LCP from heavy evals.

lisa: I'll ping eng-infra about the CDN header stripping and double-check route pool headers (X-Route-Pool). If affinity's broken, routing policy fallback could be causing cold caches.

maria: Thanks. If hotfix doesn't land by 11:00 UTC, rollback to 2.2.9 for EU. Please keep updates here.

kevin: Starting patch now. Will post canary bake results in ~15m.

jen: If you need quick numbers: add a telemetry probe with `perf.mark('hydra-start')/perf.mark('hydra-end')` around hydration to get fine-grained timings in the trace — helps validate fix.

maria: Good call. Also add a metric for chunk-eval-duration.

lisa: Notifying @support and @customer-success so they can preemptively triage tickets.

maria: Keeping thread for rollback decision. Thanks all.
